clues.it: Sergio era seduto su una sedia, accanto a un barile o a una cuccetta e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Sergio was sitting on a chair, beside a barrel or a bunk and in the Galley.

clues.it: Dario era nella 10ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a nord di Giada.
clues.en: Dario was in the 10th column, in the 2nd row and north of Giada.

clues.it: Giada era seduta su una sedia e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Giada was sitting on a chair and west of Dario.

clues.it: Vito era nella 1ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Anna.
clues.en: Vito was in the 1st column, in the 4th row and in a different room from Anna.

clues.it: Anna era nella 6ª colonna e nella 5ª riga, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Anna was in the 6th column and in the 5th row, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 6ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Marta.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 6th row and in a different room from Marta.

clues.it: Tea era nella 9ª colonna e nella 7ª riga, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Tea was in the 9th column and in the 7th row, but was not beside a plant.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a un barile e a ovest di Anna.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a barrel and west of Anna.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 11ª colonna e accanto a un salvagente, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 11th column and beside a life ring, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: Marta era da sola in Cabina, ma non era accanto a una cuccetta.
clues.en: Marta was alone in the Cabin, but was not beside a bunk.

clues.it: Olga era nella 12ª riga, accanto a una cassa e in Plancia.
clues.en: Olga was in the 12th row, beside a crate and on the Bridge.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 10th.

steps.it: Solo Giada può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 4ª è sua.
steps.en: Giada is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 4th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Ugo può stare nella 6ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Ugo is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Rosa's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 8th, column 5th.

steps.it: Solo Paolo può stare nella 9ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 12ª è sua.
steps.en: Paolo is the only one who can be in the 9th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 12th is theirs.

steps.en: Fabio is the only one who can be in the 10th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.

steps.en: Marta is the only one who can be in the 11th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 12ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 12th, column 3rd.
